episode_summary: Valerie Fitzgerald shares her journey from a struggling single mother to a top luxury real estate agent in Los Angeles. She emphasizes the importance of courage, blind faith, and strategic risk-taking in building a successful business. Valerie also discusses leveraging AI for content creation and SEO, offering practical advice for agents looking to break into the luxury market.
